en.headline: Cafe Landmark set to reopen Friday at Landmark Atrium
en.dek: The first-floor balcony restaurant in Central, closed since early July for renovation, returns on 4 September after more than two decades on the atrium.
body: Cafe Landmark is scheduled to reopen on Friday, 4 September, at Shop 107-108 on the first floor of Landmark Atrium on Queen's Road Central, after shutting on 4 July for renovation. Operator Maxim's Caterers said in July that the restaurant would close for refurbishment and return under the same name later in the year.

The dining room has occupied the atrium balcony since 2001, looking down on the mall floor through the glass roof. The restaurant said the refurbished interior draws on a Tuscan terrace, keeping booth seating while changing the colour palette. It described the new menu as French cooking with Japanese elements, and said familiar dishes such as Boston lobster pasta would remain available in revised form.

From 2.30pm the restaurant is offering a dessert trolley: two cakes or pastries, a scoop of ice cream or sorbet, and coffee or tea for HK$268, with more than ten sweets listed on a rotating selection. Local reports said a lunch set would start at HK$380. The listed reservation number is 2526 4200.

OpenRice still lists pre-renovation hours of 8am to 9.30pm Monday to Saturday and 9am to 9.30pm on Sunday and public holidays; the operator has not separately published a confirmed timetable for the first days after reopening. The nearest rail exits are Central station Exit G and Hong Kong station Exit C.

zh.headline: 置地廣場Cafe Landmark周五重開
zh.dek: 中環置地廣場中庭一樓露台餐廳総初因翻新停業，營運商美心集團早前確認保留原名，定於9月4日重新開業。
body: Cafe Landmark定於周五（9月4日）在中環皇后大道中置地廣場中庭一樓107至108號舖重開。餐廳自7月4日起因翻新暫停營業。營運商美心集團7月表示，店舖會暫時關閉進行裝修，稍後以同一店名重新營業。
餐廳自2001年起設於中庭露台，可俯瞰商場地面及玻璃天幕。店方表示翻新後的裝潤以托斯卡尼露台為靈感，保留卡座，並調整色調。新餐單以法式菜式加入日本元素，店方指波士頓龍蝦意大利麵等熟客菜式會以調整後的版本繼續供應。
餐廳稱每日下午2時半起推出甜品車，客人可選兩款蛋糕或酥點、一款雪糕或雪葡，另配咖啡或茶，售價268港元，每日輪換十多款甜品。本地報道指午餐套餐由380港元起。訂座電話為2526 4200。
OpenRice仍列出裝修前的營業時間為周一至六上午8時至晚上9時半，周日及公眾假期上午9時至晚上9時半；店方尚未另外公布重開首數天的確實時間。最接近的鐵路出口為中環站G出口及香港站C出口。
